balls.text: cracking way to end the innings! He makes room but the attempted yorker doesnt come off well, it's a pitched up delivery and he crashes it past deep extra cover
Zaheer gets a juicy full toss  but he only succeeds in hitting it straight to Badrinath at wide long-off
fires it full and he squirts it to cover for a single
makes room and squeezes out a yorker to the on side
makes room and the ball balloons quickly off the outside edge down to third man
bowls a yorker and he digs it out past the bowler
Tendulkar squeezes out a yorker down the pitch and his partner darts off, Harbhajan sacrifices his wicket and it's an easy direct hit for Oram
and Harbhajan of Slapgate fame makes his return to the IPL with a delightful slog off over midwicket, nice timing on that shot
full and wide and he squirts that down to third man

lucky boundary for Tendulkar, he steps down, makes room and scoops it flat down to long-off but the fielder was a few yards too many in front of the rope,he leaps up in despair as the ball clears him, that's his fifty as well, well played sachin!
the slower ball claims him, he chips down the track and Oram cleverly drops it short, he ends up flat batting it straight to Thushara at long-off
ends the over with a yorker which he squeezes to the off side, the nightmare's over for Freddie
one more for the road says Nayar! He stays pretty far back at the crease and that allows him to get on top of the bounce and thwack it over deep square-leg
that's No.2 for the over! This time he stays at the crease and clubs a full toss over deep midwicket, plenty of power behind that shot
he bashes a low full toss back to the bowler and Flintoff nearly gets hit on the face, he falls to the pitch and palms the ball away
that's the first of the IPL and Nayar should feel proud he has taken on the most expensive player! He stays at the crease to a pitched up delivery and bludgeons a flat six over wide long-on
much fuller and he plays with the movement down to fine leg for a couple
pitches it up and Nayar goes for a big heave over wide mid-on, not very well timed but good enough for the ball to dribble to the boundary
Hayden does well to intercept a firm square drive at deep cover, they scamper through for the second run and credit to Hayden for keeping Nayar on his toes
fullish and drifting on the pads and he places it in the deep on the on side
full and wide outside off and he gets forward and places it wide of third man
makes room, moves his front foot towards the on side to execute a delectable scoop over the covers, the follow through was also excellent
he's got his eye in alright! The short stuff gets too predictable and he stays at the crease and clubs it over midwicket, more power than timing on that one
exposes his stumps and squirts a yorker length ball down to extra cover
the ball fizzes past his body and Tendulkar wisely sets off and steals a bye to spare Nayar against a rampaging Flintoff
pretty nippy bounce this time and Nayar pokes at it outside the offstump, batting isn't terribly easy here
makes room and chops it wide of point and gets off the strike
makes room but the slower ball forces him to tap it softly down to point
pushed very firmly down the pitch and it beats the bowler, 2 fielders in the deep cut it off
full outside off and he pushes it wide of mid-off to get off the mark
pushes it to point and that gives Nayar the strike

another catch off the second attempt and this time it's Hayden, Bravo sizes up for the pull but he fails to pick the slower ball he doesn't get the desired elevation at deep square leg, hayden runs forward, nearly makes a mess of it but recovers to take the catch
plays a very wristy shot but finds midwicket
wide outside off and he really has to reach out to chop that past point
goes for a wild slash outside off but it's effective enough to beat the keeper, no slips so that's a boundary for the taking
angles it on the body and he clips it down to square leg
gets off the mark with a push to long-on

nice reflexes from the bowler! Duminy attempts a full blooded pull past the bowler but plays too early and the ball spoons off the top half of the bat and goes to Gony's right, he fumbles and takes it at the second attempt
glides it down to third man for a single
wrong choice of shot, he gets on his knee too early to paddle that away and the ball clips his body and rolls away
driven straight and the ball sneaks past the stumps, there's a lot of hesitation over the second run but common sense prevails
full on the stumps and he clips a low full toss to square leg
bangs  it in short but doesn't challenge the batsman with any pace, he swivels and bludgeons it past square leg
pushes hard at a full delivery  but the ball stops on him and he doesn't time it as well, he still manages to beat the bowler
stands tall at the crease and squeezes it past the gap between cover and point
gets off the mark with a clip to square leg
Appeal! The ball comes back in and clips his thigh pad before rolling away to point, Gony reckoned that was hitting the stumps, no Sir it wasn't

Dhawan falls to a typical 'backyard cricket slog' , the ball is short and stops on him, he swings too early and the ball clips the top edge and gives Dhoni the easiest of catches running forward from midwicket

another Sachin special, he moves across his stumps to a full ball and nonchalantly clips it away wide of square leg, Flintoff does really well to try and pull it back and the third umpire takes a look, the doubt is whether he released the ball before his thigh touched the rope, apparently he has pulled it back, excellent commitment
full outside off and pushed very firmly through the line to long-off
stays at the crease and fetches it from just outside off and swings across the line, he finds the yawning gap at midwicket
back to back fours, he bowls it fuller outside and he gets forward and bashes it over the covers
he gets it right this time, same as the previous ball, he waits for it to come onto him before scooping it over the vacant slip region, bends his knee slightly, that's masterclass
tries to cheekily scoop it over the slips region but the extra bounce catches him by surprise
tries to crash that past mid-off but the ball shoots through much quicker and beats the edge
just rap it with soft hands and run, that's Dhawan's plan and he's doing it pretty well
that's an excellent slower ball, has Dhawan in a tangle, don't ask me how that missed the top of the stumps
pushes it to the off side for a single
too short down the leg side and Dhawan easily works it on its way over short fine leg's reach, bad ball and well dealt with
defends with soft hands and

not the best of pulls over mid-on but he still places it well clear of the fielders, Dhawan runs across the pitch as he tries to make his ground but only just manages to make his ground before Patel whips off the bails, the decision is referred
moves across his stumps and squirts the ball to the off side for a single
pulls hard and finds Oram at deep midwicket
swing and a miss, Dhawan fails to make contact outside off
steps down and tries to thwack it wide of mid-off but mistimes th shot
that's a Tendulkar special! He knows fine leg is up close as he gets on his knee and paddles it well clear of the fielder, he attempted that off the previous ball too
tries to paddle it from outside off but the ball clips him low on the pad and rollsa away
tip and run is the way to go, this time to the off side and it tests out the fielders
leaves the right hander and he fails to make contact with the ball
shapes to pull but he plays too early and thumps it to midwicket
gets width outside off and he cuts hard and there';s hesitation for the second run, Tendulkar sends him back and the throw is to the wrong end
stops on him but he gets bat down on time and pushes it to the off side
gets width to free his arms and he gets a thick outside edge which scorches towards third man
a wild slash off the front foot and he misses it completely
tip and run again, they're coming in singles
defends a slower ball with soft hands and calls quickly for the run, Oram underarms the ball to the stumps but he;s home
hops at the crease and clips it in front of square leg
gets forward and taps it with sift hands to cover and sets off quickly
sprays it wide outside off and has the batsman playing a very loose drive, no contact whatsoever
gets off the mark for his new franchise straightaway, he's cramped for room as he chops it down just wide of the stumps and sets off, Patel underarms the ball onto the stumps but the batsman's home

tame dismissal and Hayden makes up for his earlier lapse, it's full and swinging in and Jayasuriya chips it straight to Hayden at midwicket, he takes it very comfortably just off the ground, timed that too well
fires it full outside off and he places it firmly to the off side
fullish on the pads and he places it to the on side
unlucky for Thushara! He swings it in and nearly hits the yorker length but Jayasuriya swings across the line and gets an inside edge past the stumps and pumps his fist
swings across the line and finds midwicket
short outside off and he carves it over point for a couple

Was that a Drop?, he tries to work it to the on side but the ball rises sharply and there appeared to be two sounds before reaching Hayden at slip who drops a sitter, the question is if Tendulkar got an inside edge onto his pads
taps it with soft hands and yells 'yeah, yeah' before setting off for the single
short down the leg side and he glances it off his gloves and beats a diving Patel, nobody patrolling that area to cut it off
waltzes down the track and Flintoff bangs it in short and slightly wide, Jayasuriya fails to make any contact
gets a really long way across his stumps and clips it to fine leg
gets forward and tries to squirt it past the packed off side field but Raina's alert, he slides and cuts it off
loose shot as he makes room to carve it over cover, no contact with the bat there
fuller and he plays his trademark clip over midwicket, Oram;s there on the boundary to save it
a bit too short and Jayasuriya likes it there as it sits up nicely, allows him to swing and connect off the meat of the bat and place it wide of square leg
he tries to loft that out of the stadium and misses it completely, that's a nice shadow golf swing
tucks him up for room and he taps it softly in front of gully and sets off
he gives him the charge and Gony drops it short, Jayasuriya adjusts well and carves it over backward point
the ball stops on him and balloons safely in front of point
brillisnt stuff by Oram at mid-on, Tendulkar drives on the up and the ball's in the air for a while, Oram flings himself to his left and palms it off
tries to cart another shortish delivery but plays with soft hands, the ball rolls to second slip
too short and asking to be hit, Tendulkar has the time to rock back and cart it over extra cover
chance for a run out! Gonty darts across, falls and tries to shatter the stumps at the bowler's end in one motion but misses the stumps, cheeky single in the end
he has Tendulkar flashing at a wide one outside off, impatience creeping in
drops it on a good length and he turns it wide of square leg
that's the first of the tournament! Steaky as he plays with soft hands and the ball travels off the outside edge and beats second slip, runs to third man
goes for a wild slash outside off and the ball rockets off the outside edge and nearly beats Oram at third man who does well to cut it off
fuller in length and he clips it hard down to square leg
There's an appeal straightaway! Goes for a wild swipe across the line and the ball clips his pads outside the line of off, can't give that out
lands it on the pads and he clips it wide of square leg
continues over the wicket, lands it full outside off and he pushes it down to point
he;s off the mark with a gently forward push wide of mid-off, a little too full by Gony
good bounce and carry, there;s inward movement as well and Tendulkar watchfully lets it go
he asks questions by getting it to dart back and clip Tendulkar's pads and lob to the keeper, there's an appeal
hits the short spot straight away and he taps it softly toward short midwicket and sets off quickly, they scamper the single
Malinga raises his arms after Thushara takes a single to long-off
slower ball and down the leg side
bowls the slower ball and Thushara fine tunes his slog, too bad the ball was nowhere in the picture
it's a reverse swinging full toss and I don't think Dhoni saw that properly, pace like fire and the ball clips the pads and pushes the legstump back
fast inswinging yorker, another single, this time down to long-on, nothing much you can do with that
hoicks it down the ground to long-on ,ask Dhoni himself to describe the bat twirl / recoil after playing that shot!
full and swinging in and he forces it hard to long-off
that ends an excellent over, forced to the off side and it doesn't cost more than a single
makes room and he whacks this down to deep extra cover
Zaheer fields well off his own bowling, another effective yorker length ball
Zaheer's not making this easy, Dhoni pounds a full delivery down to long-on and it's only a single
swings hard at a full delivery but doesn't time it well enough, long-off picks it up
yorker on middle and off and he slams this down to mid-off
it's a low full toss and Dhoni bashes it forcefully past the bowler, long-off picks it up
slower ball and he swishes it down to deep midwicket
into the stands! can we have the ball back please? The bounce suits Joginder who clubs this one down to deep midwicket
yup! And Joginder swings at a slower one and misses again, this was just wide of the leg stump
poor Joginder swings and misses again, Bravo's winning this battle, slower ball next?
goes for an almighty heave across the line and grunts after missing the ball, Chennai should cut down the dot balls
fullish on the pads and he clips it past square leg, it tests the fielder at the boundary but he ensures it's only 2
jabs another yorker down to mid-off and they scamper the single
fullish on the stumps and squirted to the off side
forces it down to Dhawan at long-off and they take the second run, Zaheer whips off the bails and Joginder's struggling, the third umpire takes a look
priceless, given the situation! Stays at the crease, gets forward and slams a pitched up delivery over wide long-off, no emotion from Dhoni
fires the yorker and he digs it out towards the keeper and takes a chance with the single, Shah's throw is wide
fires it full outside off and Dhoni gets lucky as the ball rockets off the outside edge down to third man, no slips and it;s four
swings hard and gets a thick outside edge which drops short of third man
gets a mean bouncer first up and Joginder slaps thin air and weaves out of the way

Badrinath goes for broke and that's another timely breakthrough for Mumbai! He stays at the crease and tries to smash it over long-on but the ball swirls to Bravo who's a few yards in front of the rope
gives him width and Dhoni goes hell for leather, the ball flies off the top edge and races to third man
a full and fast inswinging yorker and there was nothing much he could do besides squeezing it back to the bowler
fires it full and he defends
gives him the charge and deposits him over long-on, a flat six and the ball boy fails to hang onto the catch

Pinal Shah makes up for his earlier lapse in style! Oram goes downtown again but doesn't make proper contact, the top edge lobs towards short cover and Shah keeps his eye  on the ball and takes it after falling forward
makes a bit of room, chips down the track and carts him high over long-on
fullish on the stumps and steered to the off side
full and beaten outside off
bangs it in short and Dhoni clubs it past square leg, Harbhajan's agile at the rope
tries to force it past the covers but ends up placing it straight to the fielder
slower ball and slightly short, he plays it late and angles it down to third man
fullish outside off, he punches it hard down to long-off
fullish on the pads and tucked down to square leg
The ball is full outside off, he gets on his knee to crash that past the covers but Zaheer shows good reflexes in falling to his right and taking it inches off the ground
well played! It;s a low full toss and he escorts it through the line and beats short  fine leg
full on the offstump and pushed down the ground
Hayden goes down town in style, so much intent on that shot as he took a few paces down and biffed a low full toss straight down the ground
attempts a reverse paddle but the ball lands on the blockhole outside off and he fails to make contact
bowls it full and wide on seeing him advance, he settles for a single down to long-off
down the leg side and he pushes it down to square leg
fullish outside off and punched hard down to point
fires it full and flat on seeing Hayden advance and the batsman flicks it to midwicket
gets well forward and pushes it down to long-on
full on the stumps and pushed back to the bowler
Dhoni faces his first ball and he tries to squirt it past point
full outside off and he fails to make contact
Flintoff goes for broke over the on side but gets a tame leading edge which balloons to the off side, Harbhajan takes the easiest of catches and pumps the air
heaves a full delivery down towards midwicket
fires it on the blockhole and has him in a tangle, the ball squeezes between his legs and rolls to fine leg
forces a full delivery down to long-off
pulls and takes a single
fullish outside off and squeezed to the off side
juicy low full toss and Flintoff smokes it over midwicket after making room at the crease, one bounce and four
full outside off and squeezed to the off side
exposes his stumps and pushes a yorker length ball wide of mid-off
fired full and flat and Hayden forces it down the ground
makes a lot of room and chops the ball wide of cover
checks his shot, Harbhajan's taking a lot of pace of the ball and forces Hayden to curb his aggression
he now sprints towards his left and intercepts a firm push, good stuff from the bowler
powers it hard down the pitch and the first signs of aggression from Harbhajan as he flings the ball back towards Hayden, nobody hurt
forces it hard down the ground to long-on
takes a few paces down the pitch but checks his shot
Hayden v Harbhajan round 1 - punched hard down the ground, incident-free
fullish outside off and crashed through the covers, there's protection in the deep
bowls it on the blockhole and he jabs it towards mid-on
bowls it too full this time and Hayden escorts it over extra cover this time, Jayasuriya;s there to save it
bowls the legcutter and lands it too short, that's too easy for Hayden as he stays at the crease and biffs it over point
he toys with the bowler by getting across his stumps and paddling it high over short fine leg, the ball lands just in front of the rope
Raje comes round the wicket, not a bad ball but a terrific shot as Hayden gets marginally forward and punches it past backward point
takes his hand off the bat handle as he forces it back to the bowler
strays wide down the leg side, fails to control the swing there
smashes it hard down the pitch and Malinga manages to palm it away
the ball dipped on him quite a bit and he somehow manages to pat it away in front of the stumps
fullish outside off and squeezed out to the off side
yorker again and Malinga reckons it was hitting him in front of the legstump, not quite but a good slower ball all the same
another lucky boundary and Chennai will take it! Flintoff gets an inside edge off a screeching yorker and the ball beats the stumps and the keeper before the blink of an eye
full outside off and there's enough timing to beat the fielder at mid-off, elegant shot by Flintoff
Flintoff is the beneficiary of a thick outside edge which sails over third man, have to feel sorry for the bowler, there was enough pace on the ball to clear the boundary
drifts down the leg side and wide called, tried to pound it to fine leg
very nearly a timber strike for Bravo! Flintoff exposes his stumps and swings across the line and the ball just sails over the bails
take that! Too short and the bounce sits up well for Flintoff who swivels and smokes it over midwicket, one bounce and four
walks across his stumps and Bravo tucks him for room, he settles for a defensive push to the off side
slightly slower and Flintoff carefully places it down to point and tells his partner to wait
forces it down the pitch and Zaheer intercepts it, the non-striker scampers back at his crease
fullish on the offstump and he opens the face of the bat and places it to third man
full on the pads and pushed back to the bowler
driven hard but he can't pierce the packed off side field
pushed straight back to the bowler
excellent judgement by Raje! Raina stays right  back at the crease and tries to bludgeon it over deep square leg, Raje leaps and cups it over his head just in front of the rope
Dropped! Hayden swings and gets a thick top edge which swirls in the air for ages, Pinal Shah calls for it but loses sight of the ball in the air and fluffs the chance
slower ball and hayden slashes hard and misses it completely
chips down the track and Bravo gets some disconcerting bounce, enough to beat Hayden's wild swish across the line
tries to glance it fine but Harbhajan does really well at short fine leg to cut it off
the over gets better and better for Chennai, it's pitched up outside off and he gets the meat of the bat behind the ball and merely pushes it past cover and mid-off
drops it short again and the bounce is good enough for Hayden to swivel and biff it over square leg
drops it short and he clips it down to square leg
full marks for timing and placement, it's angled across the left hander and Raina stays at the crease and punches it off the meat of the bat between the narrow gap at the covers
full and swinging in and Raina checks the drive and tells Hayden to stay there
full and swinging in on the pads and he whips this straight to the fielder

in the air and Dhawan nearly pulls off a stunner! Raina stays at the crease and hoicks it over midwicket but doesn't get the distance on the ball, Dhawan runs backwards as the ball swirls in the air and falls forward but the ball wins in the end
Raina's solid in defense again, he meets the ball off the middle of the bat
bangs it in on a good length and he defends firmly
gets nicely behind the line and pushes it down the track

it's that man Tendulkar again! The ball gets a little high on the batsman and comes on quickly, he gets a thick outside edge and the ball dips on Tendulkar at slip but he manages to hang on to it well and falls to his left
taps it off the backfoot to point and sets off but hayden sends him  back, Patel turns and dives back at his crease
